question.problem: Given that $X∼\text{Geom}(0.72),$ compute $P(6\le X\le 10)$ rounded to $4$ decimal places.
question.worked_solution:
If $X∼\text{Geom}(p),$ then $X$ has the following probability mass function:

$$
f(x)=\{\begin{aligned}(1-p)^{x-1}p, & x=1,2,3,… \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}\end{aligned}
$$

Here, $X∼\text{Geom}(0.72),$ so the distribution of $X$ in this case is

$$
f(x)=\{\begin{aligned}{(0.28)}^{x-1}(0.72), & x=1,2,3,… \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}P(6\le X\le 10) & =P(X\in \{6,7,8,9,10\}) \\  & =P(X=6)+P(X=7)+P(X=8)+P(X=9)+P(X=10) \\  & =f(6)+f(7)+f(8)+f(9)+f(10) \\  & ={(0.28)}^{5}(0.72)+{(0.28)}^{6}(0.72)+{(0.28)}^{7}(0.72)+{(0.28)}^{8}(0.72)+{(0.28)}^{9}(0.72) \\  & ≈0.0017.\end{aligned}
$$
